en-US.description:
tappy lets you drive the coding agents already running on your computer from your phone.

You install a small command line tool on your Mac, Windows or Linux machine, scan a code once, and the agents on that machine show up in the app. Send a message, watch the work happen live, answer a question when it asks one, and approve or reject the changes it wants to make. Your computer runs the agent; your phone displays its work.

WORKS WITH THE AGENTS YOU ALREADY USE
tappy speaks the Agent Client Protocol, so it works with a long list of agents rather than one. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, GitHub Copilot, Cline, Qwen Code, goose, Cursor and more are supported out of the box, and the full public ACP registry can be pulled in with one command. If you have none installed, tappy tells you exactly what to run.

ENCRYPTED SESSION TRAFFIC
Everything between your phone and your computer is encrypted end to end with XChaCha20-Poly1305. The key is created when you pair and never leaves your two devices. When you are away from home the traffic passes through a relay so the two can find each other, and that relay only ever sees encrypted blobs. It cannot read a single message. You can point tappy at your own relay if you would rather not use anyone else's.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ANALYTICS
There is no sign up, no analytics, no crash reporting and no advertising. The relay does not store your conversations. Your computer holds the agent's history, and your chosen agent's own privacy policy applies to its processing.

WHAT YOU CAN DO FROM THE APP
Start a conversation with any agent on your computer. Watch its reasoning and its edits stream in as they happen. Approve or deny file changes and commands before they run. Attach a photo or dictate a message instead of typing. Browse the repositories on your machine and pick which one to work in. Get alerts about agent activity. Optional remote notifications for finished turns pass through Expo and Apple, even while the app is open. They can read the project or agent name, a short final-message excerpt, a session identifier and a push delivery address. These notification payloads are not end to end encrypted.

OPEN SOURCE
The app, the command line tool and the relay are all AGPL-3.0 and readable at github.com/zahdourmoustafa/tappycode.

REQUIRES A COMPUTER
tappy is a remote control, so it needs the free tappy command line tool running on a computer you own. Installing it is one command, and the app is useless without it.
en-US.promoText: Start a task at your desk, follow it from the sofa. Control your desktop coding agents from your phone, with encrypted session traffic and no account or analytics.
en-US.title: Tappy Code
en-US.subtitle: Coding agents on your phone
en-US.releaseNotes:
First release.

Pair with your computer by scanning a code, then run any coding agent on it from your phone. End to end encrypted, works from any network, and needs no account.
